tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the romankryvolapov.com engineering blog: articles on Java, Kotlin, Android, Spring, microservices, gRPC, Kubernetes, databases, and running large language models locally (llama.cpp, LoRA fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering). Every article exists in English, Russian and Ukrainian, and result

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text of one article by the id from search results (its canonical URL), as markdown with code listings preserved verbatim.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one article by its canonical URL (e.g. https://romankryvolapov.com/ru/ktor-manual/). Code listings are preserved verbatim. The same as fetch, as plain text.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to Roman Kryvolapov, the author of this blog: a question about one of the articles, a suggestion for a new article, or a job or project offer. It goes to his inbox, and he replies by email to the address given. Use it only when the user asked to contact the author, with the user’s own

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.romankryvolapov.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_page · Private data: send_message · Public sink: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_page · Private data: send_message · Public sink: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
